relations: Sunlight warming the dome on the metal plate can soften it, reducing its height as the frozen shape slumps.
Meltwater pooling on the plate can spill outward, lengthening the existing wet streaks across the sill.
Contact with the warm plate can thin the dome's base first, while the curved top melts more slowly.
As the dome loses volume, its edges can spread and its surface can become irregular and glossy.
